external_model_input.source: original PNG at image_relpath (pixels only; no mask, bbox or metadata)
external_model_input.color: single grayscale channel, 8 bit (mode 'L'); other modes are rejected
external_model_input.geometry: whole image scaled down proportionally to fit (PIL.ImageOps.contain), centred on a black canvas; no crop, no stretch
external_model_input.side_rounding: Pillow rounds the scaled side with Python round() (half to even)
external_model_input.centering: offset = (target - scaled) // 2; an odd remainder lies right/bottom
external_model_input.scaling: float32(uint8) / 255 -> [0, 1]; fixed, nothing estimated from data
external_model_input.flatten: none - the CNN receives the image array, no flattening transformation
external_model_input.note: same external preparation as the small CNN

in_model_transformations.result: (N, 160, 160, 3), three identical channels, no colour information

in_model_transformations.equivalent_to: official MobileNetV2 preprocessing applied to [0, 255] data (x/127.5 - 1)

internal_backbone_input.note: black padding becomes -1; no preprocess_input and no second division by 255

architecture: input 160x160x1 float32 in [0, 1] (external division by 255 happens once in the data preparation)
RandomFlip('horizontal', seed=42) - active only while training (augment_flip)
Concatenate([x, x, x]) - three identical channels (gray_to_rgb), 160x160x3
MobileNetV2(input_shape=(160,160,3), alpha=1.0, include_top=False, weights='imagenet', pooling=None), trainable=False, called with training=False (mobilenetv2_backbone), output (5, 5, 1280)
Dense 1, sigmoid (output) - trainable, the output IS the malignant score
configuration.train_shuffle: tf.data shuffle over the whole train set, seed 42, reshuffled every epoch

evaluation.rule: score >= threshold; no optimisation or calibration

weights.note: Keras 3.15 does not verify a publisher hash for this file; the SHA-256 identifies the local file only.

frozen_evidence.fingerprint_definition: SHA-256 over shape, dtype and bytes of all backbone weights, trainable or not, incl. BatchNorm moving mean/variance

probe.data: first 16 TRAIN images in stable order

gpu.memory_note: TensorFlow allocator statistics and nvidia-smi values observed in this run; no memory limit was set by the project

environment_report.note: read only; it does not prove this process's environment

limitations: One fixed holdout, one seed and one run: no variance estimate, no significance statement; images of one case are not independent.

The comparison is between whole pipelines: architecture and ImageNet pretraining differ; the LogReg also differs in resolution and augmentation. No pure architecture or pretraining effect is isolated.
Validation selects the checkpoint and is therefore no independent final assessment.
Training curves (flip, dropout) and validation curves (inference mode) are computed under different conditions.
The seed supports traceability; byte-identical GPU training runs are not promised.
Pretrained features and the flip do not remove burned-in markers or device cues; whether they are used is not studied.
Scores are sigmoid outputs, not shown to be calibrated probabilities; the 0.5 threshold is a fixed convention.
The weight file SHA-256 is a local identification, not a publisher confirmation.
